issuer: the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (its Taxpayer Services section), on the Vanuatu Police Traffic Section's Certificate of Ability to Drive
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue's own pages: its page Information for Drivers Licence Holders (undated) and its brochure Drivers Licence (file Drivers_Licence_21.pdf; its table's bullet marks, a private-use character in the PDF's text, are kept in the quoted words). The licence is administered under the Road Traffic (Control) Act [Cap. 29]: an applicant holding a learner's licence (VT 1,500 a category, valid one year; not held) passes the Vanuatu Police Traffic Section's driving test, receives its Certificate of Ability to Drive, and takes it with the learner's licence to Inland Revenue's Taxpayer Services section, which issues the licence card. Fee: VT 5,000 for the issue of the card (the renewal fee is also VT 5,000; a re-issue VT 2,500, not held). Term: 3 years (the page's 'Duration: 3 years' and the brochure's 'Driving license is valid for 3 years'; the brochure's 'valid for one year' is the learner's licence's, in the paragraph on it). Age: the brochure's table of age requirements gives the Motor Vehicle category from 18 ('a MUST when obtaining a drivers license'; motorcycles under 50cc from 14, 50 to 125cc from 16, heavy and common vehicles from 21, not held). No identity card is issued by this office, and no exchange list is given (an international licence holder staying over three months gets a Vanuatu licence on the Police Traffic Section's approval, not held as an exchange).

sources.said: The Driver’s Licence is administrated by Road Traffic (Control) [CAP.29]. ... Driver’s licence can only be issued once the applicant has passed the driving test from the Vanuatu Police Traffic Section. ... Driver’s licence fee: VT 5,000 Duration: 3 years ... Successful applicants must submit the Certificate of Ability to Drive, at the Inland Revenue Office, Taxpayer Services section, before the driving licence card can be issued. ... Fee for the issue of the driving licence card: VT 5,000.
